subject: Typed Foreign-call construction and independent WVIR 1.31 validation
claim: Implementation commit 2cfd292202d2bbf0425b7457c6f94ada5dc81f9a emits a resolved three-argument Foreign invocation as WVIR 1.31 operation 190 and independently validates its exact canonical pointer, ABI, scalar, result, target, and reserved-field contract on the Windows development host.

runs.target: Authenticated Foreign binding and typed WVIR semantic owner

limitations: The 26-case owner ran on Windows only; Linux reproduction and paired-host qualification remain pending.
WVIR does not authenticate the native symbol, ABI spelling, no-retain promise, or no-unwind promise; production lowering must pair operation 190 with the exact retained WVFB record.
Operation 190 has no WVB encoding in this checkpoint and the source-WVB backend returns Unsupported_operation after standalone WVIR validation.
No Foreign function executes, no host address is formed, and no library or capability authority is granted.
The full 15-owner changed-file plan was not run because unrelated owners could not reveal a defect in this focused source-WVIR boundary.
